description: Add the actual backup execution layer for canonical resources and destination targets. This should cover resource adapters for the infrastructure stores that need managed backup behavior, plus operator-selectable destinations such as local archive paths, attached storage, and S3-compatible buckets. The implementation should stay declarative and adapter-based rather than accumulating hardcoded scenario logic.
name: data-backup-manager-resource-adapters-and-targets
title: Implement resource adapters and backup targets in Data Backup Manager
